source_capture_note: Freeze the exact 40 public replay episodes harvested by CR049; do not move with the live ladder.
purpose: CR049 showed that whole-action 1-NN is catastrophically off-manifold while channel imitation is uneven (market strongest, hands weakest). CR050 learns each action channel independently with train-only leave-one-episode-out feature-mask/categorical tuning and z-scored distances, then applies only high-confidence channel substitutions on top of the exact CR029 action. A development panel chooses at most two candidates; an independent larger validation panel decides promotion.
